visual.general_description: Color timeline diagram with a horizontal month axis, labelled arrows for cultures and events, cat and dog silhouette icons, and an antimicrobial therapy row beneath the axis.
visual.detailed_description: A horizontal black axis carries tick marks labelled April, May, a double-slash axis break, Oct, Nov, Dec, Jan, Feb, Mar, April, May, June and July. Above the axis, text labels with black cat silhouettes sit over the left and middle part and labels with black dog silhouettes sit over the right part; each label has a thin vertical arrow pointing down to the axis. On the left, "SUBs placed" has an arrow to the first April tick and "Urine culture: No growth" has an arrow to the first May tick. A bold heading "Cat UTI" with "Urine culture: ESBL E. coli ST162" has a long arrow ending between the Oct and Nov ticks, and a label "Urine culture: Enterococcus" has an arrow to the Nov tick. A horizontal bracket labelled "Urine culture: No growth" has five downward arrows ending at positions from between the Nov and Dec ticks to just past the Mar tick. A label "Euthanasia" with a cat silhouette has an arrow ending at the second April tick. A bold heading "Dog Cholangiohepatitis" with "Bile culture: ESBL E. coli ST162 C. perfringens" has an arrow ending between the May and June ticks, "Bile culture: E. coli C. perf" has an arrow to the June tick, and "Bile culture: No growth" has an arrow ending just before the July tick. Below the axis the left label reads "Antimicrobial Therapy". A pale teal rectangle containing a cat silhouette spans from about midway between the Oct and Nov ticks (beneath the end of the Cat UTI arrow) to about midway between the Dec and Jan ticks, with the text "Meropenem 9.7 mg/kg SC q12h" beneath it. At the right, a tan box with a dog silhouette is labelled "Amoxicillin-clavulanate 15.1 mg/kg PO q12h", a dark-green outlined box with a dog silhouette is labelled "Meropenem 12. 1 mg/kg SC q12h", and a light-blue box with a dog silhouette is labelled "Metronidazole 12.1 mg/kg PO q12h". No patient names, identification numbers, dates with a year, photographs or numeric axis values are visible.
